# Pre-Code Approval

Use this before changing product code or execution-relevant documentation.

```md
## Human Approval

- Change: <change-name>
- Approval type: pre-code
- Decision: approved | rejected | changes-requested
- Approver: <approver>
- Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Carril: light | standard | hotfix
- Scope reviewed: PRD/proposal, TD/design, specs, tasks
- Main risks: <risks or "none identified">
- Required changes before execution: <items or "none">
- Notes: <optional>
```

Execution must not start until `Decision` is `approved`.
